channel.title: BusinessHub.cy — Compliance
channel.description: Latest Compliance stories from BusinessHub.cy, Cyprus Edition.

item.title: Anti-corruption body GRECO issues new guide highlighting the importance of binding codes of conduct
item.description: GRECO's new guide mandates that anti-corruption codes of conduct for public and private sectors must be binding and enforceable with sanctions to ensure effective integrity standards.

item.title: EIOPA elects Stavros Konstantas of the Bank of Greece to its Management Board
item.description: Stavros Konstantas of the Bank of Greece has been elected to the EIOPA Management Board, bringing significant regional expertise to EU insurance and pension oversight.

item.title: Road Freight Transport: 2nd Quarter 2026
item.description: Road freight in Cyprus saw a 2.3% tonnage increase in H1 2026, despite a significant drop in tonne-kilometres, indicating shorter haulage distances.

item.title: Welcome address by the Chief Scientist for Research, Innovation and Technology of the Republic of Cyprus, Mr Demetris Skourides, at the Cyprus Fintech Summit 2026
item.description: Cyprus Chief Scientist outlines a vision for the island to become a global hub for intelligent finance and agentic AI under the Vision 2035 framework.

item.title: UAE Signs Agreement to Host 2029 World Bank Group and IMF Annual Meetings in Abu Dhabi
item.description: The UAE officially signed an agreement to host the 2029 World Bank Group and IMF Annual Meetings in Abu Dhabi, solidifying its status as a global financial hub.

item.title: EBA supports further progress on the Banking Union, including on deposit insurance
item.description: The European Banking Authority reaffirms its support for a common European deposit insurance scheme to bolster the Banking Union by 2027.

item.title: Dissolution and liquidation of investment compartment of ROVENTER REAL ESTATE of RAIF CP. VT. ROVENTER INVESTMENTS RAIF V.C.I.C. LTD
item.description: CySEC announces the initiation of the dissolution and liquidation process for the ROVENTER REAL ESTATE investment compartment of CP. VT. ROVENTER INVESTMENTS RAIF V.C.I.C. LTD.

item.title: Dissolution and liquidation of investment compartment of AN.NIK.A. SUBFUND 1 of RAIF AN.NIK.A RAIF V.C.I.C. LTD
item.description: CySEC announces the initiation of dissolution and liquidation procedures for AN.NIK.A. SUBFUND 1, managed by Argus Management Ltd.

item.title: Dissolution and liquidation of the investment compartment HEPHAESTUS FUND I of the AIF I.H. HEPHAESTUS INVESTMENT AIF V.C.I.C. PLC
item.description: CySEC has announced the dissolution and voluntary liquidation of the HEPHAESTUS FUND I investment compartment following the total redemption of its units.

item.title: Dissolution and liquidation of the investment compartment AUKA PROPERTY FUND of the AIFLNP AUKA AIFLNP V.C.I.C. LTD
item.description: CySEC announces the dissolution and voluntary liquidation of the AUKA PROPERTY FUND following the total redemption of its units.

item.title: Tender regarding ‘The Provision of Strategic Communications and Media Relations Services focusing on the European and International Media’
item.description: CySEC is seeking a strategic communications partner to manage its international media relations and reputation across European and global markets.

item.title: CySEC Warning regarding the website apex-capitalltd.com - 06/02/2025
item.description: CySEC has issued a policy statement regarding legislative amendments to the Financial Conglomerates Directive to align national oversight with updated EU standards.

item.title: Commission unconditionally approves UniCredit's acquisition of Commerzbank
item.description: The European Commission has unconditionally approved UniCredit's acquisition of Commerzbank, signaling a major push for cross-border banking consolidation within the European Economic Area.

item.title: Speech by President von der Leyen at the Enlargement Forum
item.description: President von der Leyen reaffirms the EU's commitment to enlargement, citing the economic and security benefits of the 2004 expansion as a blueprint for future growth.

item.title: Commission partially greenlights Romania's fifth payment request for €2.67 billion under NextGenerationEU
item.description: The EU Commission partially approved Romania's €2.67 billion payment request, withholding funds for six unfulfilled milestones related to energy and SME support.

item.title: Commission partially greenlights Slovakia's eighth payment request for €548 million under NextGenerationEU
item.description: The European Commission partially approved Slovakia's €548 million RRF payment request, withholding funds due to unmet environmental and energy targets.

item.title: Commission disburses another €1.71 billion to Ukraine for drones, ammunition and air defence systems
item.description: The European Commission disbursed €1.71 billion to Ukraine for defense procurement, with 40% earmarked for EU-based manufacturers under the €90 billion Ukraine Support Loan.

item.title: Opening remarks by Executive Vice-President Teresa Ribera on the Commission decision to approve UniCredit's acquisition of Commerzbank
item.description: The European Commission has approved UniCredit's acquisition of Commerzbank, marking the largest cross-border banking merger since the financial crisis to combat EU market fragmentation.

item.title: AMLA identifies AML/CFT priorities for the review of MiCA
item.description: AMLA outlines key AML/CFT priorities for the upcoming MiCA review, targeting DeFi, staking, and stablecoin oversight to close regulatory loopholes.

item.title: Press Release: AMLA consults on draft standards for an EU-wide AML/CFT database
item.description: AMLA launches public consultation on a new central EU AML/CFT database designed to consolidate supervisory data and streamline cross-border risk assessment.

item.title: ASEAN’s Brave New Frontier
item.description: ASEAN leads global growth through regional trade integration, digital frameworks, and AI adoption, signaling shifting trade patterns and new opportunities for international service providers.

item.title: Publication of the Annual Report of the Cyprus FIU for the year 2025
item.description: The Cyprus FIU (MOKAS) has released its 2025 Annual Report, detailing operational data, emerging financial crime trends, and risk assessment metrics for the past year.

item.title: 71 years Cyprus Bar Association | 1955–2026
item.description: The Cyprus Bar Association celebrates its 71st anniversary, launching commemorative publications and media to honor its history and role in the evolution of the Cypriot legal system.

item.title: EXTENSION TO THE CYPRUS BAR ASSOCIATION (C.B.A.) ELECTRONIC PROCEDURE REGARDING THE COMPLETION OF THE ANNUAL MEMBER COMPLIANCE QUESTIONNAIRE FOR THE YEAR 2025
item.description: The Cyprus Bar Association has extended the deadline for the 2025 Annual Member Compliance Questionnaire to November 2, 2026, following technical issues.

item.title: New Regulation (EU) 2023 / 1230 on Machinery – Requirements for Importing New and Used Machinery into Cyprus
item.description: Cyprus's Department of Labour Inspection issues guidance for the transition to the new EU Machinery Regulation 2023/1230, taking full effect in January 2027.

item.title: MOKAS and Cyprus Compliance Association sign Strategic MoU
item.description: MOKAS and the CCA have signed a strategic MoU to improve public-private cooperation against financial crime through joint training and insight sharing.

item.title: Signing of a Memorandum of Understanding between the Cyprus Bar Association and the Cyprus Compliance Association
item.description: The Cyprus Bar Association and Cyprus Compliance Association have signed an MoU to enhance cooperation, training, and knowledge exchange for compliance and legal professionals.

item.title: ANNOUNCEMENT – MONEYVAL
item.description: MONEYVAL will conduct a critical evaluation of Cyprus's AML/CFT framework from May 13-24, 2019, requiring high-level readiness from legal and administrative service professionals.

item.title: EU/EEA banks display strength amid a challenging risk environment
item.description: The EBA's Q2 2026 Risk Dashboard reports strong capital (16.1% CET1) and high profitability (11.3% RoE) for EU banks despite geopolitical and macroeconomic uncertainties.

item.title: The EBA publishes its 2027 Work Programme
item.description: The EBA's 2027 Work Programme focuses on finalizing the 2024 banking package, DORA/MiCA implementation, and enhancing supervisory efficiency through data sharing and regulatory simplification.

item.title: EBA CRR3/CRD6 dashboard shows banks maintain capital levels well above minimum requirements under the fully loaded Basel III framework
item.description: EU banks remain resilient with a 15.1% CET1 ratio despite stricter Basel III/CRR3 output floor requirements, showing manageable capital shortfalls through 2033.

item.title: The EBA publishes Final Report on draft amendments to technical standards on prudential requirements for central securities depositories
item.description: The EBA has updated prudential standards for Central Securities Depositories (CSDs) to accommodate the CSDR Refit, facilitating banking-type ancillary services between CSDs while managing systemic risk.

item.title: The EBA releases the final technical package for release 4.4 of its reporting and Pillar 3 disclosure framework
item.description: The EBA has finalized the technical package for reporting framework 4.4, integrating IFRS 18, ESG disclosures, and upcoming AMLA risk assessment requirements.

item.title: European Supervisory Authorities set priorities for 2027
item.description: The ESAs' 2027 Work Programme prioritizes DORA implementation, AI oversight, and sustainable finance to ensure cross-sectoral financial stability and consumer protection across the EU.

item.title: The EBA classifies USDC as the first significant e-money token in the European Union
item.description: The EBA has designated USDC as the EU's first 'significant' e-money token under MiCA, triggering enhanced dual supervision by European and national authorities starting November 2026.

item.title: The EBA extends some consultation deadlines due to website maintenance
item.description: The EBA extended public consultation deadlines to October 26, 2026, following a temporary website shutdown caused by critical software security flaws.

item.title: The EBA appoints Kristīne Černaja-Mežmale as its new Vice-Chair
item.description: Kristīne Černaja-Mežmale has been elected as the new Vice-Chair of the European Banking Authority (EBA), effective November 2026.

item.title: The EBA advises on targeted simplifications to Taxonomy disclosures
item.description: The EBA has proposed targeted simplifications to EU Taxonomy disclosure requirements to reduce complexity and improve reporting efficiency for financial institutions.

item.title: The EBA publishes revised Guidelines on internal governance, delivering greater proportionality and simplification for banks
item.description: The EBA has updated internal governance guidelines to align with CRD VI, focusing on responsibility mapping, third-country branch oversight, and simplified proportionality.

item.title: The EBA outlines next steps on supervisory reporting simplification and extends implementation timelines following consultation feedback on the ITS
item.description: The EBA is simplifying supervisory reporting for EU banks, introducing proportionality measures and extending implementation timelines for new standards until December 2027 and 2028.

item.title: The EBA publishes consumer factsheet on white-labelled financial products and services
item.description: The EBA has released a consumer factsheet to clarify the roles of providers versus brands in white-labelled financial services, promoting transparency in digital banking.

item.title: The EBA streamlines the 2027 EU-wide stress test with more than 55% reduction in requested data
item.description: The EBA is streamlining the 2027 EU-wide stress test by cutting data requirements by 55% and introducing a mandatory climate risk assessment module.

item.title: Speech: Navigating the Crosscurrents of a Changing World Economy
item.description: IMF Managing Director Kristalina Georgieva highlights AI, high energy prices, and record public debt as the three primary challenges facing the global economy ahead of the 2026 Annual Meetings.

item.title: Governments need to make greater use of asset-backed pensions to support retirement incomes, OECD says
item.description: The OECD urges governments to address a growing retirement contribution gap by strengthening asset-backed pension schemes and improving financial advice regulations.

item.title: The Rise and Fall of NPLs in Cyprus: Solved, Transferred or Transformed?
item.description: The Central Bank of Cyprus examines the historical trajectory and current state of Non-Performing Loans, highlighting the transition of debt from banks to credit acquiring companies.

item.title: Aggregated data for Credit Servicers (CSs) and Credit Acquiring Companies (CACs) - 30 June 2026
item.description: Central Bank of Cyprus data for June 2026 shows a stable loan portfolio of €19.3 billion with NPLs at 94.6% and a decrease in properties held.

item.title: The CBC leaves the countercyclical buffer rate unchanged at 1,5%
item.description: The Central Bank of Cyprus has maintained the countercyclical buffer rate at 1.50%, effective January 2026, to ensure long-term banking stability.

item.title: Announcement regarding fine on Banque SBA Cyprus under Money Laundering Law
item.description: The Central Bank of Cyprus has fined Banque SBA Cyprus €750,000 for non-compliance with anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing regulations.

item.title: Euro area international trade in goods deficit €10.3 bn
item.description: The Euro area shifted to a €10.3 billion trade deficit in September 2026, driven by surging energy import costs and a narrowing surplus in machinery.

item.title: Commission sends Supplementary Statement of Objections to PPC over predatory pricing in the Greek wholesale electricity market
item.description: The European Commission has intensified its antitrust investigation into PPC's predatory pricing in the Greek wholesale electricity market between 2013 and 2019.
